description: Dataset for the paper : Prediction and uncertainty quantification of drought in North Benin is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. Dataset: Prediction and Uncertainty Quantification of Drought in North Benin This dataset accompanies the research article titled "Prediction and Uncertainty Quantification of Drought in North Benin" and includes meteorological and hydrological time series data used for modeling and evaluating drought events at six localities: Banikoara, Gogounou, Kandi, Karimama, Malanville, and Segbana. Coverage: Benin. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. The repository dates the deposit 2025; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
